Manage account phone numbers

Usage:
  plivo numbers [command]

Aliases:
  numbers, number

Available Commands:
  buy         Rent a phone number (requires --yes; spends money)
  cnam        Caller-ID Name (CNAM) lookup for a US/CA number (spends money — requires --yes)
  compliance  Regulatory compliance for phone numbers (requirements, applications, linking)
  get         Get details of a rented number
  list        List numbers rented to your account
  masking     Number-Masking sessions (privacy-preserving call/SMS bridge)
  release     Release a rented number (requires --yes; stops monthly billing)
  search      Search available numbers to rent
  update      Update settings on a rented number

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for numbers

Global Flags:
      --all                auto-paginate through all pages
      --api-url string     override the REST API base URL (or set PLIVO_API_URL) — for pointing at a non-production gateway
      --dry-run            print the HTTP request without sending
      --explain            explain what the command will do before executing
      --log-level string   log level: debug|info|warn|error|none (default "warn")
      --no-color           disable colored output
  -o, --output string      output format: table|json (default: table for TTY, json otherwise)
      --profile string     named profile from ~/.plivo/config.toml
  -q, --quiet              suppress non-data output
      --timeout int        request timeout in seconds (default 30)
  -y, --yes                skip confirmation prompts

Use "plivo numbers [command] --help" for more information about a command.
